## 4.0-S4

- **Pipeline `->` (§4.20):** LHS bound whole as context value, RHS (ArrowExpr per spec) evaluated once with focus (S,1,1); new `PipelineExprNode` + `IrOpCode.Pipeline` between cast and arrow precedence.
- **Mapping arrow `=!>` (§4.22.2):** parse-time desugar to `U ! F(., A, B…)` via prepended context-item argument (static + dynamic targets).
- **Focus functions (§4.6.6):** `fn` keyword in inline functions; brace-only `fn { E }` desugars to `function($Z) { $Z -> E }`.
- **`for member` / `for key value` / `for key` / `for value` (§4.14.1):** `ForBindingKind` on quantified bindings; VM `For` opcode expands array members / map entries (XPTY0141 on wrong item kind, `at $pos` across expansion, XQST0089 dup checks).
- All new syntax → XPST0003 in 3.1/3.0 mode; traversal cases added wherever `ArrowExprNode` had one (optimizer, static validator, streamability analyzer, pattern compiler, accumulators, module visibility, XQuery compiler).

## Gates

- Build 0 errors; unit all green (+31 tests, Api.Tests 199); QT3 **exactly 31,142/0/679**; XSLT smoke 162/0/26 identical
- **Full XSLT sweeps (basic + schema-aware) by the parent before merge — XSLT-project files touched this slice.**

Docs synced: FEATURE_REQUESTS (S4 row), INTEGRATION §0, AGENT_HANDOVER fifty-ninth session. Recorded follow-ups: `fn:some`/`fn:every` HOFs (S5), `=?>` (with records), member bindings in XQuery tuple clauses.
title: feat(xpath40): REQ-118 4.0-S4 — pipeline/mapping arrows, focus functions, member/key bindings
